title: QCA - the concept a question tests and the approach that answers it

concept.description: The law, relation or principle itself, stated as short as it can be stated. A formula where there is one: 'F = ma', 'V = IR', 'p1 = x1 p1 degree (Raoult)'. A named principle where there is not: 'conservation of mechanical energy'. NOT a sentence about the question.

approach.description: One line on how that concept is applied HERE, naming the quantity solved for. 'F = ma on the block, then a = v^2/2s from kinematics.' NOT a full worked solution, and never the answer option.

also_uses.description: Further relations the route needs, same short form as `concept`.
